# Edge Cases

Place boundary-testing skill fixtures here.

## Subdirectories

### `unicode-content/`

SKILL.md with non-ASCII characters in name, description, or body content.

### `large-file/`

SKILL.md approaching or exceeding reasonable size limits (test parser performance).

### `empty-optional-fields/`

SKILL.md with present but empty optional fields (empty strings, empty arrays).

### `circular-references/`

Skills that reference each other (if applicable to the spec).
